equality: exact typed scalar equality; ordered element equality for lists; canonical element equality for sets; no coercion, case folding or Unicode normalization
contains: list or set membership under exact same-type scalar equality
set_equal: same-type sets only; independent of supplied order
to_set: convert a scalar list to a canonical frozen set by eliminating duplicate elements; supplied set parameters still reject duplicates
exists: true when at least one collection occurrence satisfies the predicate; false on empty input
exactly_one: true when exactly one occurrence satisfies the predicate; duplicate list occurrences count separately; false on empty input
unique: the checked identical-path equality names a scalar key; true iff occurrence keys contain no duplicates; true on empty input
scope: lexical quantifier binding with hygienic generated names; nested bindings may shadow and never leak; declared rule_ref arguments may use the active scope
composition: existing short-circuit all/any/not, direct rule_ref, String ordering, scoped scalar and collection values
compatibility: versions 1 through 3 remain byte-identical on supported inputs; factory defaults unchanged
